title: Petkit Filter Replacement Overdue
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=petkit:status
| stats latest(filter_days_remaining) as filter_days_remaining by device
| where filter_days_remaining<7
| sort filter_days_remaining
description: Uses Petkit device maintenance exports telemetry to monitor filters that are close to the end of their service window in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for consumables that will soon affect water or air quality, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Petkit device maintenance exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Device table of filter days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds filters that are close to the end of their service window so you can spot consumables that will soon affect water or air quality before it becomes annoying.
